job.title: AI Engineer
job.description:
PRA has been engaged to build out three engineering tracks across the financial services sector for a client in Sydney. Hiring at three levels: Senior AI Engineer, AI Engineering Lead and Senior AI Engineering Lead

You'll take LLM applications and agents past the prototype and into production, in an environment where they have to be trustworthy.

The role
  • Build LLM-powered applications and agentic workflows in Python on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, using foundation models including Claude and frameworks such as Strands Agents or LangGraph
  • Engineer retrieval and context: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, and MCP servers connecting models to enterprise tools and data
  • Make quality measurable with evaluation datasets, automated evals and regression tests for prompts, retrieval and agent behaviour
  • Run AI like real software with IaC, CI/CD, tracing and cost monitoring, plus guardrails, PII handling and audit logging
  • At Lead level and above: own AI platform architecture, take use cases such as customer servicing, lending and financial crime to production, and grow a team
What you'll bring
  • Senior AI Engineer: 3-6 years, including 1-2+ years building ML or GenAI. Lead: 6-10 years, including 3+ in ML/GenAI. Senior Lead: 10-15 years, typically with 4+ in ML/GenAI
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on LLM work on AWS (Bedrock or SageMaker AI), covering RAG, prompt design and tool use
  • At least one AI solution you've taken past proof of concept into production and kept running
  • Financial services or regulated industry experience is preferred
It's a bonus if you've worked with AgentCore, MCP, LLM-as-judge evaluation or AI guardrails, have a consulting background, or hold AWS GenAI or ML certifications.

Culture
  • An AI engineering community at the front of what these platforms can do, sharing what works
  • Mentoring and coaching at every level
  • Hybrid in Sydney, with time on site with the team at agreed intervals
What's on offer
  • $120k-$240k package, depending on level
  • Permanent, or contract at $800-$1,200 per day
  • Support to gain AWS AI and ML certifications
  • A fast process: CVs reviewed within 48 hours and no take-home or live coding test
If this sounds like an opportunity for you or someone you know, "Apply now" or message Guy Nardo at PRA for a confidential conversation. These roles have the opportunity to start before Christmas.

job.title: Pega Lead
job.description:
The opportunity
We’re looking for a Lead Pega Engineer to be the principal technical authority and client-facing anchor for a dedicated four-person delivery pod: two onsite in Sydney and two offshore. You’ll bridge client enterprise architecture, business product owners and the delivery team. This is a fully hands-on role. You’ll write solution architecture documents, set case lifecycle patterns, enforce guardrails and build high-complexity components yourself, while directing offshore sprint execution.

What you’ll do
  • Solution architecture and design: Lead end-to-end Pega technical design, including application-layer cakes, enterprise-class structures, reusable rule architecture, and data virtualisation patterns.
  • Client engagement: Facilitate Direct Capture of Objectives (DCO) sessions with Sydney-based product owners, business analysts and enterprise architects, and turn business requirements into robust technical specifications.
  • Hands-on engineering: Build high-complexity case types, core decision frameworks, security models (RBAC/ABAC) and critical enterprise integrations.
  • Pod governance: Steer the pod through daily technical reviews, govern code quality, keep guardrail scores above 95%, and resolve architectural bottlenecks.
  • Integration and security: Architect secure, real-time integrations (REST/SOAP, OAuth2, Kafka/JMS, SSO) and lead downstream platform alignment.
  • Release and DevOps: Work with client release management to define deployment pipelines, packaging strategies, and automated testing via Pega Deployment Manager.
What you’ll bring
  • 8–12+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with at least 6 years in enterprise Pega Platform implementations
  • Pega Certified Lead System Architect (CLSA), or CLSA Part 1 completed with a proven Lead Architect track record
  • Expert knowledge of Pega 8.x and Pega ‘23+, Enterprise Class Structure, Case Management, Decisioning, Constellation UI / Theme Cosmos, and performance tuning (DB Trace, PAL, PLA)
  • A track record of client-facing consulting in the Australian enterprise market, such as financial services, insurance, telecommunications or the public sector
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and executive presentation skills
Ready to lead? Apply now with your CV and CLSA details.

job.title: Principal Platform Engineer
job.description:
• $190k to $210k + bonus
  • Melbourne, 4 days a week in office
  • Generous parental leave, share plan and leadership learning
About the opportunity

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role in the central platforms function of a large ASX-listed organisation. The team builds and runs the platforms the rest of the business relies on, and this role sits at the heart of that work: setting cloud architecture patterns across AWS and Azure, steering the next stage of a container-based hosting platform, and guiding application workloads through migration.

You'll report to the head of cloud, platforms and infrastructure and work directly with development teams, so the standards you set show up in how software is actually built and run across the organisation.

The role
  • Define landing zones, reference designs and architecture patterns across AWS and Azure
  • Lead the design and ongoing evolution of the container-based application hosting platform
  • Set the observability, infrastructure as code and automation standards development teams build on
  • Guide migration strategies for application workloads based on complexity, risk and business criticality
  • Step into complex incidents and escalations across infrastructure, networking and application layers
What you'll bring
  • 10+ years in cloud, infrastructure or platform engineering, including large-scale enterprise cloud delivery
  • Deep AWS expertise, with landing zone, multi-account and well-architected experience
  • Hands-on design and operation of Kubernetes, ECS or similar container platforms
  • Extensive Terraform, CloudFormation or Pulumi, embedded in CI/CD pipelines
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and leading cloud migration programs
Hands-on Azure is highly regarded, as are cloud or Kubernetes certifications, multi-cloud experience and a software development or DevOps background.

Culture
  • Agile delivery (Scrum or Kanban) alongside development teams
  • Close collaboration with security, architecture and enterprise IT
  • Room to evaluate and adopt new cloud tooling where it genuinely improves developer experience
  • A purpose-led, values-driven organisation
Ready to shape how cloud is done at enterprise scale? Apply now, or contact Daniel Naidoo daniel.naidoo@pra.com.au for a confidential chat.

job.title: Information Protection Engineer (Purview)
job.description:
• Great annual salary on offer!
  • Brisbane based, hybrid role
  • Shape the roadmap and own this orgs Purview capability into BAU
About 
Our client is part way through a cyber maturity uplift as part of a greater business transformation, and needs an Information Protection Engineer to join them as they continue this uplift, working heavily with Microsoft Purview.

This is not a ticket-taking engineering role. You'll go out into the business, work out what's really sensitive, and turn that into controls people can live with. Once the project wraps, this role will become the organisation's ongoing information protection capability, and that capability is yours.

The role
  • Take ownership of the Microsoft Purview system: sensitivity labels, auto-labelling, DLP and, as maturity allows, enforcement and encryption
  • Design, build and tune custom Sensitive Information Types for data inbuilt classifiers can't handle
  • Analyse reporting and production data to diagnose false positives and negatives and recommend improvements
  • Build the Purview roadmap, covering what to turn on, what not to, and when, including SharePoint and Defender for Cloud Apps integration next year
  • Act as the go-to for Purview questions and issues, translating between technical and business teams
What you'll bring
  • Hands-on Microsoft Purview implementation experience you've owned end to end at least once
  • Proven experience developing custom SITs and refining policies based on real data
  • The confidence to engage the business directly and work out requirements without having data handed to you
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical people alike
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender, Defender for Cloud Apps and Sentinel
Nice to have: a Microsoft security certification, Queensland Government information security policy knowledge, SaaS DLP experience and Power BI reporting skills.

Culture
  • Initial you'll be part of a small, capable project team, plus the wider cyber team around you every step of the way.
  • Self-directed: you'll be trusted to set direction, not just follow it
  • Hybrid, getting together in the office to be with your colleagues 2-3 days/week
  • Learning and development, study assistance and a wellbeing program
If you've owned a Purview rollout and enjoy the people side as much as configuration, APPLY NOW or get in touch with Carrah at carrahj@pra.com.au for a confidential chat.

job.title: Cyber Security Consultant
job.description:
• Fixed term permanent role- 12 months
  • Brisbane CBD, hybrid 
  • Build and own the assurance process from the ground up
About the opportunity

Our client is delivering a multi-year technology transformation program. As new systems are introduced, each must be assessed against the organisation's security control requirements before entering production. To meet this demand, the Cyber Security team is seeking a Cyber Security Consultant to support the ongoing security assurance process and to take ownership of that process once it's fully implemented. The role operates within a well-governed environment and works closely with Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), architecture and approvals functions.

The role
  • Support the design and implementation of a security assurance system, and own its ongoing operation
  • Assess systems against the Australian Government Information Security Manual (ISM) and NIST CSF 2.0, obtaining evidence that required controls have been implemented
  • Conduct technical security risk assessments, or refer them to the GRC function as appropriate
  • Provide oversight of the assessment work performed by security analysts, including prioritisation and quality review
  • Provide security advice and guidance to project and technology stakeholders
  • Engage with GRC and the approvals function to support informed decisions
Selection criteria
  • Substantial experience in cyber security governance, risk and compliance
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and embedding a security control or assurance framework within an organisation
  • Experience in security assessment and authorisation using the ISM Risk Management Framework, NIST RMF or equivalent
  • Sound judgement in interpreting control requirements within the context of the organisation
  • Well-developed stakeholder engagement and written communication skills
Experience within financial services or government, and a relevant industry certification such as CISSP, CISM or CISA, will be highly regarded.

How to apply
If this sounds like something you've done before and would like to do again, please click APPLY NOW. For a confidential discussion, contact Carrah Jordan at carrah.jordan@pra.com.au or 3071 7200.

job.title: Automation Test Engineer | Sydney | Contract
job.description:
• $800 to $950 per day inc Super
  • Sydney, hybrid (3/2 in office)
  • Pairing culture and active testing Guild community
About the opportunity:

 A large insurer is uplifting the way it tests its integration layer, and needs a senior automation tester to set the standard. You'll join an integration delivery squad working across a modern API and microservices ecosystem, with the remit to build quality in from design through to deployment rather than bolting it on at the end. It's a hands-on role for someone who writes the framework, not just runs it, and who wants their work to shape how a whole engineering group approaches automation.

The role:
  • Own the automation strategy and delivery for API and microservices testing, building scalable automated regression suites
  • Develop and maintain API test frameworks in Java 11+, JUnit 5 and Rest Assured, covering REST APIs and API security
  • Embed automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines (Bamboo, Bitbucket/GitHub)
  • Run performance and reliability testing with Gatling, using service virtualisation (Hoverfly, Wiremock, Mockserver) for isolated, reliable testing
  • Support production readiness through observability tooling such as Splunk
What you'll bring:
  • 5+ years as a senior tester, with expert-level test automation in Java 11+ and JUnit 5
  • Hands-on Rest Assured, Spring Boot, Gradle, Swagger and Postman/Bruno, plus JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Solid grasp of REST APIs, API security, microservices, service discovery and distributed tracing
  • Gatling and service virtualisation experience (Hoverfly, Wiremock or Mockserver)
  • CI/CD, Docker and cloud concepts, working within Agile/SAFe
Nice to have:

Java 17+, the Netflix stack (Zuul, Ribbon, Eureka), API contract design, DB2, and insurance or banking experience.

Culture:
  • Pairing is part of how the team works
  • Active Communities of Practice and Guilds you'll be expected to contribute to
  • Ownership mindset, with flexibility to step across into dev work where the squad needs it
  • Cross-functional collaboration with engineering and delivery teams
What's on offer:
  • 6-month contract, ASAP start
  • Good chance of extension
  • A senior remit to set automation standards across a modern API stack
Interested? " Apply now " or reach out to Guy Nardo at guy.nardo@pra.com.au or 0452 664 264 for a confidential chat.

job.title: CloudOps Engineer
job.description:
• Salary: $160k-$170k + bonus
  • Location: Melbourne, 4 days a week in the office
  • Growth: help shape AI-enabled automation for cloud operations
About the opportunity

A large national organisation is looking for a hands-on Cloud Operations Engineer to help build and run its cloud platforms across AWS & Azure. This is a role where you'll own infrastructure as code day to day, keeping a busy multi-cloud environment secure, reliable and cost-effective, while working closely with application teams and vendors.

It's also a chance to get in early on how AI-enabled automation can change cloud operations. Alongside core platform work, you'll help introduce better automation tools and practices, and build a community of practice around the technologies the team has chosen.

The role
  • Provide first and second-level support for cloud issues, troubleshooting across the infrastructure
  • Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code using Terraform
  • Help deliver cloud projects from design and cost analysis through to build
  • Introduce and improve automation tools and processes, including AI-enabled automation
  • Take part in the team's on-call support rotation
What you'll bring
  • Hands-on infrastructure as code (IaC) experience, especially Terraform, building secure, reusable, version-controlled infrastructure
  • Experience building, deploying and supporting workloads in AWS and/or Azure
  • Containerisation experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Competency in at least one scripting or programming language, plus CI/CD and change control experience
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and clear written communication, including technical documentation
Great to have: SRE and observability, AWS ECS, cloud security and cost management, Entra ID/IAM/DNS, or experience with 24/7 mission-critical systems.

Culture
  • Close collaboration with application teams and vendors
  • A team that values finding better ways of working and owning its impact
  • Room to share knowledge and help build a community of practice
If you're a Terraform-first cloud engineer who enjoys keeping production platforms healthy and wants to push automation further, apply now or get in touch with Daniel Naidoo daniel.naidoo@pra.com.au for a confidential chat.

job.title: Data Science Lead - 6 month contract
job.description:
Data Scientist Lead - 6 month contract

Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist Lead to drive the development and delivery of advanced analytical solutions, with a particular focus on decision engines, Next Best Action (NBA), propensity modelling and predictive analytics.
The role will suit a commercially minded Data Science leader with strong traditional machine learning expertise and the ability to translate complex analytical outputs into actionable business strategies. You will lead the development of predictive models that support customer decisioning, personalisation, customer engagement and business optimisation.
A key component of the position is the ability to work across cross-functional teams, influence senior stakeholders and navigate complex project environments to ensure data science initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the design, development and implementation of decision engines and Next Best Action capabilities.
  • Develop and optimise propensity models, predictive models and customer segmentation solutions using traditional machine learning techniques.
  • Translate business objectives into analytical solutions that support customer targeting, engagement, retention and conversion.
  • Drive the development of predictive models that inform real-time and near-real-time business decision-making.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where data science can improve commercial and operational outcomes.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional delivery teams across Data Science, Data Engineering, Technology, Product and Business functions.
  • Communicate complex analytical concepts and model outputs to senior stakeholders, translating insights into clear business recommendations.
  • Manage competing priorities, dependencies, delivery milestones and project risks across multiple initiatives.
  • Influence decision-making across business and technology teams, ensuring alignment between analytical solutions and broader organisational objectives.
  • Establish best practices around model performance, validation, monitoring and continuous improvement.
Required Skills & Experience
  • Extensive experience in Data Science, Predictive Analytics and Machine Learning.
  • Strong experience developing propensity models, Next Best Action solutions and decision engines.
  • Solid understanding of traditional machine learning techniques, including:
    • Logistic and linear regression
    • Decision trees, Random Forest and Gradient Boosting
    • Classification and regression modelling
    • Customer segmentation and behavioural modelling
    • Predictive scoring and propensity modelling
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience using relevant data science and machine learning libraries.
  • Experience translating analytical models into practical business decisioning solutions.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle management, personalisation and customer engagement strategies.
  • Experience leading or mentoring Data Scientists and working with Data Engineering teams to operationalise models.
Stakeholder Management & Leadership
  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement, communication and relationship management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage senior business and technology stakeholders.
  • Experience navigating complex cross-functional environments and influencing decisions without direct authority.
  • Strong understanding of broader project delivery, including planning, dependencies, governance, risks and stakeholder alignment.
  • Ability to bring together business, technology, product and analytical teams to drive outcomes.
  • Commercially focused, with the ability to connect data science initiatives to measurable business value.
 Apply now to lead decisioning and Next Best Action analytics on a 6-month contract in Sydney.

job.title: Mainframe Security Engineer
job.description:
Mainframe Security Engineer (RACF) | 12-Month Contract |

Melbourne or Sydney
  
Are you a RACF specialist who's happiest finding a better way of doing things,  rather than just keeping the lights on? 
  
This is a chance to join the mainframe security engineering team at one of Australia's leading banks, in a role that's focused on innovation and continuous improvement as much as day-to-day security.
  
About the opportunity
  
You'll join the Mainframe Security Engineering team inside the bank's Group Security function, and sit within the area focused on innovation. 
  
The team protects the security integrity of mainframe systems that support millions of customers. It's also tasked with modernising how access control is delivered, through better tooling, automation and simpler processes.
  
The role
  
  • Design, deliver and maintain RACF security solutions across the bank's mainframe environment
  • Find and deliver process improvements, automation and risk reduction across the mainframe estate, with results you can measure in time and cost saved
  • Provide technical expertise and assurance on projects, from validating requirements and making design decisions through to testing and deployment
  • Evaluate tools, techniques and security frameworks to improve how access control is delivered
  • Work with internal and external audit and Enterprise Controls, and lead remediation where needed
  • Mentor more junior members of the team
  
What you'll bring
  
  • 15+ years of mainframe experience, including 10+ years in a security role with advanced RACF expertise
  • Advanced JCL and REXX skills, plus solid hands-on use of ISPF (including Dialog Management Services) and SDSF
  • A background in audit, risk and controls, and a good understanding of regulatory obligations in a technology environment
  • Programming experience in at least one other language, ideally Python or Assembler
  • Clear communication and documentation, and the ability to become a trusted advisor to stakeholders
  • A tertiary qualification in technology or a related field
  • SAS programming experience is highly regarded but not essential.
  
The team
  
You'll work closely with the Mainframe Identity Services and Identity and Access Management leaders, technology and business users, and audit teams. The team values quality, attention to detail and people who take an initiative from first idea through to successful deployment.
  
What's on offer
  
  • 12-month contract with a major Australian bank
  • Based in Melbourne or Sydney, your choice
  • High-impact work shaping the future of mainframe security, not just BAU
  
Interested?
  
Apply now with your CV, or reach out to Emily Cawley at PRA for a confidential chat on 0411 436 349 or emily.cawley@pra.com.au.

  • Build and maintain React and TypeScript web applications, including role-based business workflows
  • Design and integrate REST APIs using OpenAPI, plus asynchronous event-driven integrations
  • Build and maintain infrastructure in AWS CDK and contribute to CI/CD, testing and security practices
  • Take part in code reviews, solution design and knowledge transfer to the team

About the opportunity
Join a well-known national retail brand as a hands-on React & React Native Developer in its digital team. You'll work across mobile and web on a shared React Native, React and TypeScript codebase, building customer-facing features that are used at real scale.

This is a chance to get your foot in the door with a major retail brand on an immediate-start contract through to March 2027. With significant new work planned for 2027, there is high potential to extend.

  • A straight-talking manager who values direct communication

What's on offer
  • Contract starting early November 2026 through to the end of March 2027
  • High potential to extend as new work kicks off in 2027
  • Hybrid working arrangement, with 3 days per week in the office 
  • A chance to get your foot in the door with a large national retail brand
Ready to code every day in an AI-first team? Apply now!

job.title: Recruitment Specialist - Sydney
job.description:
Recruitment Specialist - Sydney
  
WHO IS PRA?   

PRA is a leading Digital & IT Recruitment company with offices in Brisbane, Sydney, Canberra and Melbourne.
  
PRA offers all its employees’ industry leading financial incentives, flexible working arrangements, training and genuine career growth in Sydney and interstate.
 
Some of the key benefits are;

  • High financial rewards with commission up to 50%
  • Cloud based technology, so you can work from home or on the move
  • External / Internal training and continuous improvement programs
  • Career opportunities into management
  • Work Perks such as up to 25 days leave per year, team events, lunch clubs, sales comps and many more.  
  
What is the role?   
Working out of our very cool Sydney office, you will build your own accounts and networks. We will help you to develop your business and ensure your success as a best in class recruitment and technology professional.

You are able to work on both contract and permanent roles and you can build up significant revenue streams whilst placing permanent candidates. 

We have multiple positions available, such as:
  • Candidate Manager 
  • Associate Consultatant
  • Recruitment Consultant
  • Senior Consultant
  • Managing Consultant
  • Principal Consultant
  • Client Services Manager   
Consultants within PRA are responsible to develop long term relationships with clients and to offer a professional and effective service to clients and candidates.  Delivery and the style of the delivery are paramount to maintain and develop the image of PRA as a leading supplier of recruitment solutions.
What will you do?
  • Selling and promoting PRA’s services to existing and new customers
  • Expanding PRA’s reach within each customer through business development activities
  • Managing and maintaining client accounts for PRA’s services through consistent communication and client visits
  • Assessing clients’ needs and providing services and solutions that satisfy client requirements
  • Co-ordinating with PRA’s internal resources to ensure customers receive best in class service
  • Providing timely and regular reporting to both internal and external stakeholders
  • Utilising market knowledge to pitch new clients and win new business
  • Dealing with clients & candidates, developing long term effective relationships
  • Negotiating rates with clients, both contract and permanent
  • Giving presentations to clients
  • Handling clients and applicants through recruitment process to successful conclusion
  • Writing advertisement copy
  • Selection of applicants for vacancies
  • Interviewing applicants
  • Arranging interviews with clients and candidates
  • Ensuring contact is made on a regular basis with contractors once placed out on the client’s site
  • Maintaining awareness of trends within area of technical specialisation
  • Ensuring that contact is made with clients on a regular basis and updating the database
What kind of person thrives in the PRA environment?   

Communication and people management are the defining elements of this role.  To perform it successfully, a candidate will need to be confident, and possess the ability to inform and persuade others and effectively present both themselves and the organisation they represent.  Friendliness and charisma are important factors in performing such a job effectively, together with the ability to put others at their ease.

Attention to detail, responsiveness and adaptability are also key elements in this job.  You will have energy and enthusiasm, and the ability to deal confidently with changes in work environments and situations.  The job often calls for work to meet deadlines or be completed within short timescales, and the ideal candidates will be prepared to commit themselves if they are to succeed.

Recruitment is challenging and fast-moving, and there are times you will practice patience to see through a difficult time or a minor repetitive task.  Having said this, you will see that these periods as necessary to your personal advancement and will contribute to your own goals in life, and in return you will work towards a career that is rewarding and flexible!
What will you have done before?   
  • Min 2 years experience working with a range of stakeholders within the recruitment industry
  • Excellent communication skills, both written & verbal
  • Working autonomously & within a team, doing everything in your power to ensure your colleagues success as well as your own- recognising that the greater teams’ success will always benefit you personally
  • Attention to detail and an enjoyment of being busy; managing multiple moving pieces at one time
  • Min 2 years experience in a Business Development capacity
This role attracts a Base salary of $89,000- $100,000 Pkg+ OTE  

Apply now for immediate consideration
